# Deplai booking demo

> A real, working meeting-booking app at https://demo.deplai.app — pick a 30-minute
> slot, leave your details, get a confirmation on screen. It exists to show what
> Deplai (https://deplai.eu) puts online and keeps running: an app of the kind an AI
> tool writes for a small business, deployed on a real address, in Estonian and
> English. Bookings made here are real but demo data is deleted every night.

## What this app is
- A booking page for a free 20-minute consultation with Deplai about getting an AI-built app online
- Also a live demonstration: the same app a hairdresser, coach or repair shop would use to take bookings
- Built with AI tooling, deployed and maintained by Deplai on a server in the European Union
- Source code: https://github.com/deplaiou/deplai-booking

## What a visitor can do
1. Pick a free slot — weekdays, 09:00–15:00 Estonian time (Europe/Tallinn), 30 minutes, up to 10 working days ahead, minimum 2 hours' notice
2. Fill in name, email, the topic of the call and optional notes
3. Get a booking reference on screen; Deplai follows up by email

## What it does not do
- It does not send an automatic confirmation email; the booking reference is shown on the page
- It does not take payments and asks for no payment details
- In demo mode every booking is deleted nightly at 03:00 UTC, so nothing is kept

## How it is built
- Nuxt 4 (Vue 3) with server-side rendering, so every page is readable without JavaScript
- Nitro server routes for the API; SQLite (better-sqlite3) as the only datastore — one file, no database server
- Double booking is prevented by a UNIQUE constraint on the slot start time, not by application logic
- Posted times are validated against the generated slot list, so a handcrafted time is rejected
- Two languages from one codebase via @nuxtjs/i18n: Estonian at "/", English at "/en"
- Runs as a single container; 0.5 CPU and 256 MB is enough

## Pages
- https://demo.deplai.app/ — booking page (Estonian)
- https://demo.deplai.app/en — booking page (English)

## About Deplai
- Deplai puts AI-built web apps online and stays responsible for keeping them running, in Estonian or English
- Setup 149 € once per app; hosting from 19 €/month (simple sites) or 39 €/month (apps with a database)
- More: https://deplai.eu and https://deplai.eu/llms.txt
